name: epidemiological risk
description: Population and public-health angle: exposures, risk factors and disease occurrence across individuals and populations, with environmental and demographic context -- not the molecular detail of the mechanism (biochemical actions, genetic determinants) nor the single-patient course of care (clinical mechanisms). Entity branches of the epidemiological stratum at priority 1 (exposure event, organismal entity, disease or phenotypic feature, planetary entity, attribute, activity, study result); predicate weights derived from the Biolink hierarchy (biomedcat.weights).
reading_focus: disease: incidence, prevalence and population-level risk factors; gene: genetic susceptibility and heritability in the population, not the variant's molecular mechanism; chemical entity: environmental or occupational exposure; clinical entity: screening, uptake and health-service outcomes
